title: the worship sites
audit_comment: THE WORSHIP SITES - the last unpinned Appendix S chart read (Curtiss's five-chart-rows call, resolved by the print). The R783 handoff flagged the five clerical chart rows blocked on extraction contamination; this round re-read the chart three ways - the 1eonline.info compilation pages, the R407 pins, and the print itself (the archive.org full-text OCR of pp. 121-122) - and the verdict is clean: EVERY R407 PIN STANDS. The contamination rides the compilation side, not the repo: the site's Hanali row carries Solonor's cells wholesale (sphere, animal, raiment, colors, form, and site - the deep forest), Labelas's sphere cell prints Erevan's sphere, and the Arvoreen, Segojan, and Aerdrie rows carry site-side spelling variants (defence, Nature, sky-blue, semi-annually). THE GRID: 23 x 2 - the place-of-worship kinds (16 distinct codes: the two battlefield rows, the four dwarven underground temples, Aerdrie's open hilltops, Hanali's fountain or spring, Labelas's small grove, Solonor's deep forest, Erevan's never-the-same-place-twice, Sheela's open field, Cyrrollalee's the home, the four anywhere rows, Baervan's forest clearing, Urdlen's cavern, Segojan's subterranean temple, Flandal's underground forge, Yurtrus's crypt, Luthic's cave temple) and the cleric-gender reads (12 males-only rows, the lone Berronar females-only row, 10 either-gender rows with the Luthic exception). THE STRINGS: the printed site phrases ride rules/uascharts.h (the uscWorshipSite accessor) with a live regtest strings block checking all 23 row for row (the R782 site-block precedent). Honest boundaries: the M, F, and N-H columns on the compilation pages are the compilation's own additions, not print chart columns - they stay contract-side; the print's own typos ("can by worshiped", the one-r Cyrollalee) ride the prose; the pantheon prose stays open (R423 stands)

banner.title: THE WORSHIP SITES - the last unpinned Appendix S chart read: the place-of-worship kinds, the cleric-gender grid, and the print verdict on the contaminated chart rows
banner.provenance: The R783 handoff deferred the five clerical chart rows (spheres, raiment, holy days, sacrifice) as blocked on chart-extraction contamination. This round unblocked them: all 23 deity pages re-fetched from the 1eonline.info compilation (the repo-trusted R189 source), the chart tables parsed cell for cell, and the print itself read via the archive.org full-text OCR of pp. 121-122. THE VERDICT: every R407 pin stands - the contamination is compilation-side (the Hanali chart row carries Solonor's cells wholesale, Labelas's sphere cell prints Erevan's sphere, the Arvoreen and Segojan and Aerdrie rows carry spelling variants), so no chart repair was owed. THE PINS: the two per-row reads the chart carries that R407 left unpinned - the place-of-worship (16 distinct kinds, the prose under each chart: the battlefield pair Clangeddin and Bahgtru, the four dwarven underground temples, Aerdrie's open hilltops, Hanali's fountain or spring, Labelas's small grove, Solonor's deep forest, Erevan's never-the-same-place-twice, Sheela's open field, Cyrrollalee's the home, the two anywhere pairs, Baervan's forest clearing, Urdlen's underground cavern, Segojan's subterranean temple, Flandal's underground forge, Yurtrus's underground crypt, Luthic's temple within a cave) and the cleric-gender grid (12 males-only rows - the male dwarves, the gnomish all-male, the non-Luthic orcs; the lone Berronar females-only row; 10 either-gender rows - the elves, the halflings, Luthic). The printed site strings ride rules/uascharts.h (the uscWorshipSite accessor) with a live regtest strings block walking all 23 rows row for row (the R782 site-block precedent). Honest boundaries: the M, F, and N-H columns on the compilation pages are the compilation's own additions, not print chart columns - they stay contract-side; the print's own typos (the Erevan "can by worshiped", the one-r Cyrollalee prose) ride the prose; the pantheon prose stays open (R423 stands)
banner.sentinel: Zero new book pages: the worship-site reads ride the Appendix S pp. 121-122 chart and prose the R405/R406/R407 pins already seat, the compilation rides the R189 duty already trusted, and the print OCR rode the archive.org full-text read (the source-verification class)

bools.name: plcHanaliRowContaminationStandsPrint
bools.comment: The compilation's Hanali chart row carries Solonor's cells wholesale (sphere, animal, raiment, colors, form, site); the print's romance, bare, gold robes, fountain-or-spring row stands

bools.name: plcErevanNeverSamePlaceTwice
bools.comment: The only restriction on where Erevan can be worshiped: never in the same place twice

bools.name: plcDwarvenRestWorshipInTemples
bools.comment: Clangeddin is worshiped on the battlefield; the other four dwarves are worshiped in underground temples carved from natural rock

bools.name: plcHalflingAnywherePair
bools.comment: The halfling anywhere pair: services for Arvoreen and Brandobaris may be conducted anywhere (Sheela requires an open field, Cyrrollalee the home)

bools.name: plcOrcAnywherePair
bools.comment: The orc anywhere pair: services for Shargaas and Ilneval anywhere (Bahgtru requires a battlefield, Yurtrus an underground crypt, Luthic a temple within a cave)

bools.name: plcLuthicAllowsBothGenders
bools.comment: Luthic's worship is one of the few that allows both male and female orcs to become clerics; nearly all of the other deities permit male clerics only

bools.name: plcGenderColumnsRideTheCompilation
